set.body:
Purpose and scope
Choose at most the dominant bottleneck established by Q4, then implement a bounded SQL/index/allocation change without changing query semantics, current-authority checks or frozen membership. Use a new checksum-checked migration for index changes and coordinate numbering with publication work. If no material bottleneck is demonstrated, retain a reasoned no-change finding instead of speculative optimization.

Acceptance proof
Rerun the same seeded workload and oracle suite before/after. Report latency, plan, index/storage and ingestion tradeoffs. Historical queries and revocation remain correct; migration checks pass. Document the measured operating envelope and any remaining limit.

Start here
modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/ScientificSql.scala; modules/postgres/src/main/resources/sanctity/postgres; benchmark scripts; docs/evidence

Working agreement
Preserve the existing working-tree baseline. Use current repository contracts, keep historical identities stable, and attach actual verification commands/results before closing. Coordinate shared catalog files, profile versions and migration numbers with other work in this tranche. Planning references: docs/scientific-core.md and docs/implementation-plan.md.
set.title: Q5: Address the measured query bottleneck and retain before/after evidence
